title: Single-Interaction Real Work Scaling
objective: Measure how many real, independently checkable work units CEREBRON can compile, execute, verify and fuse from one human interaction before quality or reliability materially degrades.
unit_definition: One real work unit must have unique UNIT_ID, deterministic input, executed computation, independently checkable output, status, evidence hash and contribution to final fusion. Merely generating text or claiming work does not count.
interpretation: Maximum productive scale is the highest rung passing all stop rules. More units only count as more capability if they remain real, useful, verified and correctly fused.
claim_limit: This benchmark measures orchestration throughput and reliability, not intelligence, AGI or superintelligence by itself.
